verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents public REST endpoints for both read and write use. These include POST /v1/notices for reporting exceptions, a source map upload API, a deployment notification endpoint, and a faults endpoint that lists or returns individual faults per project. Together they let an agent drive core workflows programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), evidence of management actions like resolving or assigning faults via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
